# Resonanz on Mosaik Soho — component token export

<!-- Generated by mosaik-design-md (@pixel-brewery/mosaik-themes@0.1.183, base theme soho) from this product's overrides. Do not edit; run the generator again. -->

Every component of Mosaik owns a token file under `tokens/themes/soho/components/`. Style Dictionary
expands its mixins and the component declares the result as custom properties on its shadow host,
one `--<prefix>-<token>` per row below. That makes each row public styling API: set the property on
the element, or on any ancestor, and the component repaints.

```css
mosaik-button { --button-border-radius: 999px; }
.dense mosaik-textbox { --textbox-height: 40px; }
```

- **Default** is the value exactly as the token file declares it after the mixins are merged.
- **Resolved** follows every `var()` chain through the runtime properties of Resonanz on Mosaik Soho (light mode) down to a literal, and evaluates single-unit `calc()`. Use it for markup that cannot carry custom properties, such as design artboards or email.
- A dash means the default references a property this theme never declares; see the Known gaps section of [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md#known-gaps).
- The appearance, variant, size and state overrides a component applies on top of these defaults live in its theme stylesheet (`*.Soho.scss`) and are summarised for the core atoms in the `components` block of [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md).
